release.change: 3.0a: Added small tooltip tutorial for new users. Fixed issue where the app would assume a Bulbasaur when no goal pokémon was selected.
The app has been redesigned! You no longer need to add parents. Just store all your pokémons and the app will automatically select the best pairs!
Egg Groups are now considered! Add all your pokémons to the app, and only the ones compatible with your current goal will be selected!
Genderless pokemon logic added! The app is now able to handle genderless pokémons that can breed.
If something isn't working right for you, report it through the app and I'll try to fix is as soon as possible.
New Ditto interface! The app will now recognize dittos as a wildcard and suggest smarter combinations. Add all the dittos you own to the app for better results!
Updated suggestion interface! Instead of plain text, the app will now display a visual interface when suggesting new combinations. You can also change how the percentage works on the settings menu.
Bugfixes: Fixed random crashes when adding large amounts of eggs and dittos.

Known Issues: Unfortunately due to the nature of the changes, your current eggs may become incompatible with the app. The saving engine has been rewritten: future updates will always conserve your current data. Sorry for the inconvenience!
Shiny chance calculation! Click the clover button and select the shiny option to use it.
Equip items! Click the gender buttons to select which item to equip on the parents. You can also switch the parent with a Ditto.
